meta.Syllabus Name: Kỹ năng giao tiếp và cộng tác
meta.Learning-Teaching Method: Offline; Teaching methods: A constructivist approach and project-based learning.
meta.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 40mins final exam + 105 hours self-study
meta.Description: This course develops students’ teamwork and workplace communication skills for academic and professional contexts. Students examine how teams function and practice building trust, leadership, and conflict management while communicating effectively in collaborative settings. The course also emphasizes academic integrity, netiquette, and ethical communication as essential principles for responsible participation in academic and professional communities. Through group projects and applied activities, students develop practical skills in writing, presentations, meetings, and career communication.
meta.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final examination.
- Students are responsible for completing all exercises, assignments, and lab work assigned by the instructor, whether in class or at home, and for submitting them on time.
- Laptops may be used in class for learning purposes only.
- Promptly access the FLM system at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn
for up-to-date course information.
meta.Note:
Progress marks:
- 01 Participation: 10%
- 02 Activities: 10%
- Project:
Part 1: 10% (Project Proposal & Presentation)
Part 2: 20% (Group Project Deliverables & Final Project Report/Presentation)
- 01 Quiz: 5%
- 02 ASM: 20%
- 01 Final exam: 25%
Conditions to pass: Final exam >= 4
Grade Average >= 5/10

chunks.text:
Description: This course develops students’ teamwork and workplace communication skills for academic and professional contexts. Students examine how teams function and practice building trust, leadership, and conflict management while communicating effectively in collaborative settings. The course also emphasizes academic integrity, netiquette, and ethical communication as essential principles for responsible participation in academic and professional communities. Through group projects and applied activities, students develop practical skills in writing, presentations, meetings, and career communication.
NoCredit: 3
Pre-Requisite: N/A
Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 40mins final exam + 105 hours self-study
StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final examination.
- Students are responsible for completing all exercises, assignments, and lab work assigned by the instructor, whether in class or at home, and for submitting them on time.
- Laptops may be used in class for learning purposes only.
- Promptly access the FLM system at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn
for up-to-date course information.
Note: Progress marks:
- 01 Participation: 10%
- 02 Activities: 10%
- Project:
Part 1: 10% (Project Proposal & Presentation)
Part 2: 20% (Group Project Deliverables & Final Project Report/Presentation)
- 01 Quiz: 5%
- 02 ASM: 20%
- 01 Final exam: 25%
Conditions to pass: Final exam >= 4
Grade Average >= 5/10
MinAvgMarkToPass: 5

chunks.text: CLO1: Explain key concepts of teamwork, leadership, and team dynamics in academic and workplace contexts.

chunks.subject_name: Kỹ năng giao tiếp và cộng tác
chunks.text: CLO5: Produce professional written documents and deliver clear and persuasive presentations for academic and workplace purposes.

chunks.subject_name: Kỹ năng giao tiếp và cộng tác
chunks.text: CLO6: Develop a personal career plan and demonstrate readiness for professional environments.

chunks.text: CLO7: Demonstrate ethical and responsible communication in teamwork and professional contexts.

chunks.text:
Session 48 — MINI CAREER FAIR: Preparation
Students participate in a mini job fair simulation to practice job-seeking skills and professional communication. After the activity, students are required to complete a Mini Job Fair Report reflecting on their experience.

The format of the Mini Job Fair will be determined by the instructor.
Tài liệu: - Unit 7: Career Exploration, Blueprint for Success in College and Career
- Read slide 13.5
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: - Clearly identify short-term and long-term career goals based on personal aspirations, individual competencies, and career development orientation.
'- Develop a feasible career development plan aligned with personal direction and general labor market requirements.
'- Complete, review, and submit a CV and Cover Letter tailored to a specific job position.
